component.name: Axiotask
component.summary: Manage Google Tasks with offline editing

description.p: Axiotask is a native Google Tasks client. Browse cached lists and tasks, edit offline, and track pending changes as they synchronize with Google.

ul.li: Organize tasks with subtasks, notes, due dates, and smart views
Capture tasks quickly, search your lists, and edit tasks in bulk

description.p: A Google account and an internet connection are required to connect and synchronize. Previously downloaded tasks remain available offline.
Open task storage on a fresh Linux installation even when a data folder from version 1.5.3 or earlier is still present.
Start normally when the Linux Google configuration file does not exist yet, and remove the test-only read-only sync setting.

Restore About and version, Donate, account sign-out and switching, read-only sync, auto-sync on startup, sync activity, the completed-subtasks and haptics settings, and export preview with Copy and Share. Account backup and restore now work on Android.
Keep task editing responsive during synchronization, restore convenient task and list ordering, and hide completed subtasks by default.
Refine Android navigation, task capture and details, with predictable Back behavior and accessible keyboard and landscape layouts.
Restore Android Google authorization and launcher branding, accept Gmail task links, and recover synchronization after exhausted retries.
Prepare Linux desktop distribution with the restored Axiotask branding and updated application identity.
